name: Dam break into shallow water
setup: Dam break into shallow water: step from h = 0.25 to h = 2.5 (H0 = 1, a = 1.5).
expect: A deep column collapsing into very shallow water, the classic near-dry case. Positivity is the main question.
observed: NN alone blows up. MCL-NN keeps h positive (minimum 0.33 vs 0.31 in the DNS) with q error 8%.
